## Preliminary disclosure

We used AI to help find a dataset, develop R code, and proofread our explanations. We are responsible for checking its suggestions.

## Proposed extension

We plan to extend our baseline model by adding average product rating, review count, and product category as predictors of product sales volume. We will also investigate whether a log transformation improves the model.

## Planned verification checks

1.  Check the data joins and product-level summaries for duplicate records or inflated sales counts. Manually compare sales totals, average ratings, and review counts for several products against the original data.

2.  Check model diagnostics, including residual plots, to assess linearity and constant variance. Compare the baseline and extended models and verify that our written conclusions match the R output.
